items.question: What force overcomes the spreading manifestation of guiding Pārvatī?
premises: Pārvatī is characterized as leading or guiding.
A spreading or manifestation is attributed to her.
The throat-voice is presented as a conquering force.
items.inference: The spreading manifestation of guiding Pārvatī is overcome by the throat-voice.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of prathanam in relation to jitaḥ is context-dependent.
The instrumental force of kaṇṭha+svara is inferred from sense rather than explicit case marking.
items.plain_english: Or else the spreading manifestation of guiding Pārvatī is conquered by the sound of the throat.
